newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barges thinly quoted at lower levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barges thinly quoted at lower levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were thinly quoted at lower levels on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded Friday versus none Thursday.
- Two barges, next week, mid-Mississippi offered at 225 percent of tariff, no bid or comparison.
- One barge, week of Oct 27, lower Ohio bid 10 points lower at 205 percent, no offer.
- Two barges, week of Oct 27, mid-Mississippi (McGregor and south) bid five points lower at 220 percent, no offer.
- One barge, week of Oct 27, Illinois, bid at 215 percent, no offer or comparison.
- Four barges, one each week December, Illinois, bid at 165 percent, no offer or comparison.
- Four barges, one each week December, Mississippi (St. Louis), offered at 130 percent, no bid or comparison.
- Eight barges, one each week March, Illinois offered at 165 percent, no bid or comparison.
